_readme: unseal exchanges (Pushkin in Giran on L2Toggle; datapack: Blacksmith of Mammon 31126 + town blacksmiths): sealed piece + aa x pay (5575 Ancient Adena for S, 57 adena for A) -> the piece; docs/plan/tools/unseal_table.js
_about: Sealed -> unsealed armor / accessories at a Giran blacksmith (Pushkin; also Pinter, Kluto, Rupio ...): one sealed piece (+ adena for A-grade) -> the unsealed piece of the chosen type (t: HEAVY / LIGHT / MAGIC = robe, empty = jewel / no type). From the L2J High Five datapack multisells 1002 (B-grade gloves / boots, free), 311262506 (A-grade armor, adena) and 311262507 (A-grade jewels, adena) (Shagooh/l2j-server-datapack). The bot reads the server's live list at the blacksmith before every exchange (an entry = exactly this sealed id + adena -> this product), so a different list on this server is never guessed. Generated 2026-10-25 for UNSEAL (swarm.js).
_port: 2026-10-25 PORT-1.10.3: + rows (swarm.js usData: B gloves/boots list 1002 + A lists, with the armor type HEAVY/LIGHT/MAGIC) next to v1.10s byUnsealed / bySealed (unchanged, docs/plan/tools/unseal_table.js). Re-running unseal_table.js drops rows - keep them.
